biography.value:
在衆神降臨之前，底棲魔魚潛伏在原初的海洋與地底湖泊中。它們通過思想向外延伸，搶奪和控制凡人世界中的新興生命，將這些生物變成自己的奴隸。這種統治讓它們獲得了神一般的地位。隨後出現的真神摧毀了底棲魔魚的帝國，並解放了它們的奴隸。

底棲魔魚們從未忘記。

永恆記憶Eternal Memories。底棲魔魚擁有完美的記憶力。它們一代又一代地傳承着自己的知識。因而那些被衆神擊敗的傷痛也得以完美保留在其頭腦之中。

底棲魔魚的頭腦是古老知識的寶庫，能夠完美清晰地回顧史前的時刻。它們在無數個歲月中耐心而複雜地計劃着。很少有生物的構思設計可以達到底棲魔魚的程度。

湖中之神Gods in the Lake。底棲魔魚棲身在含水的環境中，包括海洋深處、深湖和水元素位面。底棲魔魚在其領地和鄰接的土地上是猶如神一般的存在，且還會從其統治之處獲得苛刻的崇拜與服從。底棲魔魚毀滅其他生物後，還會將獵物的知識與經驗加入自己的永恆記憶中。

底棲魔魚使用其心靈感應力量來讀取生物的頭腦並瞭解其渴求。底棲魔魚會利用這些知識來獲得一個生物的忠誠，希望用滿足這些需求來換取服從。在它的巢穴中，底棲魔魚可以進一步使用自己的力量來改變生物的感官，比如可以讓追隨者們在假象中獲取許諾給予的報酬。

衆神之敵Enemies of the Gods。只要底棲魔魚沒有真正地死去，使底棲魔魚衰落的力量就會被赤裸而清晰地銘刻在其完美的記憶中。如果底棲魔魚的身體被破壞，它的精神就會迴歸水元素位面，在那裏用幾天或幾個月時間聚合出一具新的身體。

無論何時，底棲魔魚們都夢想着推翻衆神並重新掌控這個世界。底棲魔魚有無數的歲月來設計和準備它們的計劃，然後完美地實行。

“底棲魔魚的存在是否可能比神還要古老……在衆神降臨之前，如此恐怖的存在創造了多元位面？現在看來這真是個令人恐懼的想法。”

吉斯澤萊哲學家，瓦奇澤科爾Vaqir Zekh’r亦即《遙遠國度：尚虛之實The Far Realm: Real Yet Unreal》的作者

底棲魔魚巢穴An Aboleth’s Lair

底棲魔魚巢穴位於地下湖泊或遍佈岩石的深海中，周圍通常會環繞着那些遠古的底棲魔魚城市廢墟。底棲魔魚一生的大多數時間都會在水中度過，不過仍然會偶爾到水面接待訪客或者面見狂熱的拜者。

巢穴動作Lair Actions。在自己巢穴中作戰時，底棲魔魚可以調動周圍的魔力執行巢穴動作。先攻輪到20時（出現等值時視爲後手），底棲魔魚可以執行一個巢穴動作併產生下列效應其一：

  • 底棲魔魚對60尺內它能看到的隨意數量生物施展魅影之力phantasmal force（無需成分）。底棲魔魚在對該效應維持專注時不能執行其他巢穴動作。目標如果成功豁免，或者其受效應時效結束，則該目標在接下來的24小時內對該底棲魔魚的魅影之力phantasmal force巢穴動作免疫，不過該生物可以自願接受效應的影響。

  • 底棲魔魚周邊90尺內的水池化作洶湧的浪濤向外急衝。地面上靠近一個水池20尺內的任意生物必須進行一次DC 14的力量豁免，豁免失敗則被水沖走20尺並應擊倒地。底棲魔魚不能重複使用該巢穴動作，直至它使用一次其他的巢穴動作爲止

  • 底棲魔魚巢穴中的水體在魔力作用下可以抨擊生物的情緒。底棲魔魚指定距離自己90尺內任意數量它能看見，且身處水中的生物。每個目標必須進行一次DC 14的感知豁免，豁免失敗則受到7（2d6）點心靈傷害。底棲魔魚不能重複使用該巢穴動作，直至它使用一次其他巢穴動作爲止。

區域效應Regional Effects

底棲魔魚巢穴所在區域被該生物的存在所扭曲，造成了下列一項或多項的效應：

  • 距離底棲魔魚巢穴1裏範圍內的地下路面變成黏滑溼潤的困難地形。

  • 距離巢穴1裏範圍內的水源被超自然力量污染。底棲魔魚的敵人在喝下這些水後會嘔吐數分鐘。

  • 作爲一個動作項，底棲魔魚可以在距離其巢穴1裏範圍內某處創造一個自己的虛幻影像。這個複製品可以出現在任意底棲魔魚此前看到過的地點，或者任意被底棲魔魚魅惑的生物當前可以看到的地點。該影像在底棲魔魚對其維持專注時持續存在（如同專注於法術）。該影像沒有實體，但它擁有視覺和聽覺，也能像底棲魔魚一樣移動。底棲魔魚可以通過影像所在的位置感知、說話和使用心靈感應，如同它自身出現在該位置一樣。影像受到傷害將隨即消失不見。

底棲魔魚死後，前兩項效應將在3d10日裏逐漸衰弱消失。

Before the coming of the gods, aboleths lurked in primordial oceans and underground lakes. They reached out with their minds and seized control of the burgeoning life-forms of the mortal realm, making those creatures their slaves. Their dominance made them like gods. Then the true gods appeared, smashing the aboleths' empire and freeing their slaves. Aboleths have never forgotten.

Eternal Memories. Aboleths have flawless memories. They pass on their knowledge and experience from generation to generation. Thus, the injury of their defeat by the gods remains perfectly preserved in their minds.

Aboleths' minds are treasure troves of ancient lore, recalling moments from prehistory with perfect clarity. They plot patiently and intricately across eons. Few creatures can conceive of the extent of an aboleth's plan.

Gods in the Lake. Aboleths dwell in watery environments, including ocean abysses, deep lakes, and the Elemental Plane of Water. In these domains and the lands that adjoin them, aboleths are like gods, demanding worship and obedience from their subjects. When they consume other creatures, aboleths add the knowledge and experiences of their prey to their eternal memories. Aboleths use their telepathic powers to read the minds of creatures and know their desires. An aboleth uses this knowledge to gain a creature's loyalty, promising to fulfill such wants in exchange for obedience. Within its lair, the aboleth can further use its powers to override senses, granting creatures, such as its followers, the illusion of promised rewards.

Enemies of the Gods. The aboleths' fall from power is written in stark clarity on their flawless memories, for aboleths never truly die. If an aboleth's body is destroyed, its spirit returns to the Elemental Plane of Water, where a new body coalesces for it over days or months.

Ultimately, aboleths dream of overthrowing the gods and regaining control of the world. Aboleths have had untold eons to plot and to prepare their plans for perfect execution.

“Could it be that the aboleths are older than the gods... that before the divine ones came to be, such horrors shaped the multiverse? Now there's a chilling thought.”

— Vaqir Zekh'r, githzerai philosopher and author of The Far Realm: Real Yet Unreal

An Aboleth's Lair

Aboleths lair in subterranean lakes or the rocky depths of the ocean, often surrounded by the ruins of an ancient, fallen aboleth city. An aboleth spends most of its existence underwater, surfacing occasionally to treat with visitors or deranged worshipers.

Lair Actions. When fighting inside its lair, an aboleth can invoke the ambient magic to take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the aboleth takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects:

  • The aboleth casts @spell[phantasmal force] (no components required) on any number of creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. While maintaining @status[concentration] on this effect, the aboleth can't take other lair actions. If a target succeeds on the saving throw or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the aboleth's phantasmal force lair action for the next 24 hours, although such a creature can choose to be affected.
  • Pools of water within 90 feet of the aboleth surge outward in a grasping tide. Any creature on the ground within 20 feet of such a pool must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=14]] saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet into the water and knocked &Reference[condition=prone]. The aboleth can't use this lair action again until it has used a different one.
  • Water in the aboleth's lair magically becomes a conduit for the creature's rage. The aboleth can target any number of creatures it can see in such water within 90 feet of it. A target must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=14]] saving throw or take 7 ([[/damage 2d6 type=psychic]]) damage. The aboleth can't use this lair action again until it has used a different one.

Regional Effects. The region containing an aboleth's lair is warped by the creature's presence, which creates one or more of the following effects:

  • Underground surfaces within 1 mile of the aboleth's lair are slimy and wet and are &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}.
  • Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are supernaturally fouled. Enemies of the aboleth that drink such water vomit it within minutes.
  • As an action, the aboleth can create an illusory image of itself within 1 mile of the lair. The copy can appear at any location the aboleth has seen before or in any location a creature &Reference[condition=charmed] by the aboleth can currently see. Once created, the image lasts for as long as the aboleth maintains @status[concentration], as if @status[concentration||concentrating] on a spell. Although the image is intangible, it looks, sounds, and can move like the aboleth. The aboleth can sense, speak, and use telepathy from the image's position as if present at that position. If the image takes any damage, it disappears.

If the aboleth dies, the first two effects fade over the course of [[/r 3d10]] days.

底棲魔魚可以發動三次觸鬚攻擊。

The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

近戰武器攻擊：命中+9，觸及10尺，單一目標。命中：12（2d6+5）點鈍擊傷害。如果目標是一個生物，則其必須進行一次DC 14的體質豁免，豁免失敗則陷入疾病狀態。該疾病在1分鐘內不會產生效應，且可以被任意治療疾病的魔法移除。1分鐘後，染病生物的皮膚會變得半透而黏滑，除非其進入水中，否則該生物無法恢復生命值，此時該疾病只能被醫療術heal或者其他6環及以上的治療疾病法術移除。該生物的身體暴露到水面外時，每10分鐘會受到6（1d12）點強酸傷害，除非其皮膚在10分鐘過去之前再次接觸到水分。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+9]]{+9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 ([[/damage 2d6 + 5 type=bludgeoning]]) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=14]] saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by @spell[heal] or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 ([[/damage 1d12 type=acid]]) damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

近戰武器攻擊：命中+9，觸及10尺，單一目標。命中：15（3d6+5）點鈍擊傷害

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+9]]{+9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 ([[/damage 3d6 + 5 type=bludgeoning]]) damage.

底棲魔魚指定30尺內一個它能看到的生物作爲目標。該目標必須進一次DC 14的感知豁免，豁免失敗則如同着魔一般被底棲魔魚魅惑，直至該底棲魔魚死亡，或者直至該底棲魔魚與目標不再同處一個位面。被魅惑的目標處於底棲魔魚的控制之下且無法反抗，底棲魔魚和該目標可以無視距離通過心靈感應進行交流。

被魅惑的目標每次受到傷害時可以重投該豁免。豁免成功則結束該魅惑效應。該目標距離底棲魔魚至少1裏時，也可以重投該豁免，但這種重骰的豁免每24小時只可進行一次。

The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=14]] saving throw or be magically &Reference[condition=charmed] by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The &Reference[condition=charmed] target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the &Reference[condition=charmed] target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

底棲魔魚可以在空氣和水中呼吸。

The aboleth can breathe air and water.

處於水中的底棲魔魚會被不定型的粘液包圍。觸碰到底棲魔魚的生物，或是在其5尺內使用近戰攻擊命中底棲魔魚的生物必須進行一次DC 14的體質豁免。豁免失敗者將陷入1d4小時的疾病狀態。該疾病狀態下的生物只能在水中呼吸。

While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a [[/save ability=con dc=14]] saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for [[/r 1d4]] hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

一個生物通過心靈感應與底棲魔魚進行交流時，如果底棲魔魚可以看到這個生物時，則底棲魔魚將瞭解這個生物內心最強烈的慾望。

If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

底棲魔魚進行一次感知（察覺）檢定。

The aboleth makes a Wisdom (&Reference[skill=Perception]) check.

底棲魔魚發動一次尾擊攻擊。

The aboleth makes one tail attack.

一個被底棲魔魚魅惑的生物受到10（3d6）點心靈傷害，底棲魔魚恢復等同於該生物所受傷害的生命值。

One creature &Reference[condition=charmed] by the aboleth takes 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=psychic]]) damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

底棲魔魚擁有3傳奇動作，用來選擇執行下列動作項。它每次只可選擇執行一個傳奇動作項，且必須在另一生物回合結束時執行。底棲魔魚在其回合開始時恢復所有消耗的傳奇動作數。

  • @UUID[.Yaxz5DvA2mnSm6tE]
  • @UUID[.zmGdZrL9l6H6FSN8]
  • @UUID[.oSneHBLFel67ejuZ]

The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The aboleth regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

  • @UUID[.Yaxz5DvA2mnSm6tE]{Detect}
  • @UUID[.zmGdZrL9l6H6FSN8]{Tail Swipe}
  • @UUID[.oSneHBLFel67ejuZ]{Psychic Drain}
